doctest - The fastest feature-rich C++11/14/17/20 single-header testing framework
https://github.com/doctest/doctest

Version: 2.4.11 (latest as of 2024)
License: MIT
Downloaded: 2025-08-28

doctest is a new C++ testing framework but is by far the fastest both in compile times 
(by orders of magnitude) and runtime compared to other feature-rich alternatives.

Key Features:
- Single header library
- Compile-time and runtime performance
- Subcases for BDD-style testing
- Test fixtures
- Parameterized tests
- Thread-safe
- Minimal macros
- Can remove all tests from binary with DOCTEST_CONFIG_DISABLE

Integration:
- Include doctest.h in test files
- Define DOCTEST_CONFIG_IMPLEMENT_WITH_MAIN in one source file for standalone test executable
- Or define DOCTEST_CONFIG_IMPLEMENT for custom main
- Tests can be embedded directly in production code with DOCTEST_CONFIG_DISABLE for release builds
